what_happened: All five target declarations (revAntiIso, truthAt_rev, validOn_rev_iff, FrameClass.Sat.rev, ValidIn.reflectTime) compiled on first attempt via lean_run_code probes against the existing oleans; no proof search was needed. The generic TruthAntiIso transport plus the OpenReversal rev machinery were a precise fit, so research produced verified proof terms rather than sketches.

The dispatch specified the anti-isomorphism's atom field as provable 'by rfl'. It is not: the goal is M.valuation (tau.state t) p <-> M.valuation (tau.state (- -t)) p, which needs a change plus rw [neg_neg], matching how OpenReversal.lean's openTruthAt_rev atom case already handles it. Recorded so the plan does not specify rfl and then report a deviation.

WorldHistory.rev's respects_task proof uses abel, which is NOT transitively available from Semantics/TaskModel.lean + Semantics/PartialHistory.lean alone (unknown tactic). Verified replacement: rwa [neg_sub_neg], which compiles at that import level. This is the one blocker to siting the history-level rev in PartialHistory.lean, and it is a one-token fix.

Research report's Phase 1 (promote ~70 lines of frame-level rev machinery into FormalSystem/Semantics/TaskFrame.lean) does not fit under that file's set_option linter.style.longFile 2900 ceiling: the file is already 2896 lines, so the promotion needs the ceiling raised to 3000 plus an extended justification comment. The report did not mention the ceiling. Carried into the plan as a named Phase 1 step with a Scope Hypothesis.

Adding FormalSystem/Semantics/Reversal.lean raises the FormalSystem/ .lean file count 689 -> 690, which (a) requires regenerating the library root FormalSystem.lean via 'lake exe mk_all --lib FormalSystem' (gated by check-module-invariants.sh C33) and (b) stales typst/generated/status.typ's pinned formalsystem-file-count = 689, gated by typst-sync-check.sh Check 2. status.typ sits in concurrent task 801's declared file_scope. Research report identified neither consequence; both are now explicit plan steps with concurrency discipline.

Research report had already compiled every target declaration via lean_run_code probes (zero diagnostics, no sorry, no proof search) and reproduced the verified sources verbatim, including two corrections to the dispatch (atom is not rfl; abel must become neg_sub_neg). Planning needed no proof discovery at all: phase decomposition reduced to siting plus build sequencing, and the Lean Challenge Statements block was transcribed directly from verified signatures.

Phase 1 promotion of the converse-frame block landed first-try: both guarded scoped builds (TaskFrame, OpenReversal) exited 0 with zero errors and no longFile diagnostic, because the research report had pre-compiled the exact block.

The pre-commit typst-sync-check.sh --counts-only gate blocks EVERY phase commit until typst/generated/status.typ's formalsystem-line-count is regenerated, because any .lean edit shifts the repo line count. The plan sites that regeneration in Phase 6 only. Resolution: regenerate status.typ as part of each phase commit (the file is generated, was uncontended, and task 793's phase 1/3/5 commits set the same precedent), which costs one full lake build per phase since the generator reads '#print axioms' out of a built library.

Separately, FAIL INV fired because the new module staled four generated README inventory blocks; regenerated via --emit-inventory, and hand-fixed OpenReversal.lean's trailing description column, which the generator preserves verbatim and which still credited the module with the promoted declarations.
